title: Oscillation inequalities, lower ball growth and Sobolev embeddings on metric measure spaces
summary: We study the relation between lower ball growth, rearrangement oscillations, and Sobolev-type embeddings on metric measure spaces. We prove that a lower estimate for the ball function \[ h_μ(r):=\inf_{x\inΩ}μ(B(x,r)) \] implies pointwise symmetrization inequalities for averaged differences and Hajłasz gradients, without doubling, Poincaré-type assumptions, or extra topological hypotheses. Conversely, the validity of either family of inequalities for suitable cutoff functions recovers the corresponding lower growth estimate.
